The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT/Revenue ≈ 18%) and moderate leverage (total liabilities of 57,549M vs. equity of 64,923M), supporting an ability to service obligations through normal operations. However, liquidity is only moderate (current ratio 1.32), which tempers the rating. Overall, this points to an upper-investment-grade profile rather than a top-tier rating.

DECISION: BBB+
